execution.implementation: Figshare source identity verification, full PSF/DCD compatibility inspection, five-frame DCD extraction and reload, sampled structural metrics, and unexecuted viewer movie and export rehearsals

observations: The full PSF and DCD matched the SHA-256 values published by the MDAnalysisData accessor.
MDAnalysis loaded 4187 trajectory frames with the 3341-atom PSF.
The retained five-frame DCD reloaded with the same topology and zero maximum coordinate difference at stored precision.
The sampled all-C-alpha RMSD to frame zero ranged from 0.000000 to 7.271138 A.
interpretation: The sampled radius-of-gyration and CORE-to-LID distances are consistent with wider conformations than frame zero among the selected frames.
limitations: The compact DCD preserves selected coordinates and order; original frame indices and times are retained separately.
The derived frame-zero PDB uses chain X and writer defaults for metadata absent from the PSF; the PSF remains the topology identity.
The source trajectory is solvent-stripped and pre-aligned on the CORE domain.
Five selected frames do not characterize kinetics or equilibrium populations.
Structure Viewer loading, playback, movie rendering, cancellation, and export remain unexecuted.
rosalind_open did not submit the adenylate-kinase trajectory, render or export a movie, or execute a Rosalind scientific job.

provenance.note: The local run verified the full source pair and retained a compatible subset; viewer movie and export steps remain a rehearsal, and the genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation states that no Rosalind scientific job ran.
